card.name: Units and lab abbreviations in dosing
card.fires_on: The last piece of a unit or lab name in dosing text: the 2 in mg/m2, mg after a dose number, °F in temperatures, and ALT or AST in liver-test thresholds.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: The unit right after a dose number, such as mg or the 2 in mg/m2.
modes.example: is 35 mg/m <<2>> up to a maximum of 80

modes.label: Liver enzyme names
modes.description: ALT or AST in liver-enzyme rules for holding or changing treatment.
modes.example: ALT or<< AST>> >3 × ULN AND Bilir

modes.label: Temperature unit
modes.description: The degree-F mark closing a storage temperature range.

card.plain: It lights up on the end of a unit or lab name, like mg/m2, mg, °F, ALT or AST, in dosing instructions.
